hero.title: BioResonance
hero.description: A precision simulator for bioelectric field research. Models transmembrane potential via the Schwan equation, SAR-based thermal effects, and size-selective electroporation across user-configurable cell phenotypes and propagation media.

cells.sectionSub: Transmembrane potential and thermal response computed via Schwan equation. Drag the Field Intensity slider to explore the therapeutic window.

healthy.label: Healthy Hepatocyte
healthy.description: Epithelial hepatocyte (R = 10 µm). Lower radius and thicker membrane yield higher Schwan threshold — preserved across the electroporation window targeting larger carcinoma cells.

target.label: Adenocarcinoma Cell
target.description: Carcinoma cell (R = 15 µm). Larger radius and higher membrane permittivity produce elevated transmembrane potential under identical field conditions, enabling size-selective disruption.

comparative.title: Comparative Analysis

targeting.title: Resonance Targeting
targeting.description: Identify precise field parameters that disrupt target cells without impacting healthy tissue.

profiles.title: Extensible Profiles
profiles.description: Support for multiple cell types, viruses, bacteria, and other organisms as research expands.
